characters.name: Jocelin
characters.summary:
An unGifted Redcap in his late twenties, brown-haired and green-eyed, fond of new covenants, often the only Redcap one sees for years; he rides his horses a little hard. He has a ring of magic resistance and an enchanted shield.

Like each of the Tribunal's Redcaps, he has a device that brings him and his horse back to Mercer House from anywhere in the Tribunal, once a day.

characters.name: Perceval
characters.summary:
An unGifted Redcap in his late forties, thinking of retiring, tall, thin and balding, who never takes off his unenchanted red cap. His wife Lucy and their children live at Mercer House; Guy is ten, and Lucy thinks two-year-old Maud has the Gift. He helps any covenant in a crisis, but thinks people should manage daily life themselves. A brooch makes him and his horse invisible.

Like each of the Tribunal's Redcaps, he has a device that brings him and his horse back to Mercer House from anywhere in the Tribunal, once a day.

characters.name: Great William
characters.summary:
An unGifted Redcap of giants' blood, just under eight feet, broad, with long blond hair and beard, in his mid thirties; quick-minded, widely read and keen on magic theory. He has boots that make him walk faster and a big axe enchanted for accuracy, as he is no great fighter.

Like each of the Tribunal's Redcaps, he has a device that brings him and his horse back to Mercer House from anywhere in the Tribunal, once a day.

characters.name: Little William
characters.summary:
An unGifted Redcap, little only beside Great William: well over six feet and more solidly built, in his late thirties. He got a longevity potion from one of the Tribunal's magi and will not say whom or why. The only Redcap who wears armour as a habit, enchanted mail made lighter, and a skilled, proud fighter with sword and shield.

Like each of the Tribunal's Redcaps, he has a device that brings him and his horse back to Mercer House from anywhere in the Tribunal, once a day.

characters.name: Edgar
characters.summary:
The newest Redcap, in his early twenties, good-looking, light brown hair and grey eyes, with a way with women; he has no magical items yet.

Like each of the Tribunal's Redcaps, he has a device that brings him and his horse back to Mercer House from anywhere in the Tribunal, once a day.

characters.name: Robert Grosseteste
characters.summary: Master Robert Grosseteste, born about 1170, an official of Hugh Foliot, bishop of Hereford: a deacon with no benefice, and an unGifted natural magician learned at Schola Pythagoranis, well disposed to magi.

characters.name: Berechiah ben Natronai haNakdan
characters.summary: A Jewish natural magician of Oxford, born 1162, who may approach the Order.

source: Heirs to Merlin: The Stonehenge Tribunal, by Atlas Games, content under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence; summarised, not quoted.

talion.name: Talion
talion.summary: Praeco of the Tribunal, its eldest magus now that Immanola is gone. An ancient magus who has weathered age and Twilight remarkably, still in full possession of his faculties and, as far as anyone knows, his magic, but very careful now about casting. Once renowned for his mastery of Perdo; he favours elaborate robes of deep green and blue. The book makes him of Flambeau at a Tremere covenant and says no more of it.

iudicium.name: Iudicium
iudicium.summary: The senior quaesitor of the Tribunal, who presides at its meetings: with the Praeco, the hold that let Blackthorn keep its grip. A solid lawyer, competent wizard and capable politician, unremarkable in looks but for a writhing scarlet serpent tattooed on his left cheek by a long-ago Twilight; an ancient magus with his House's interest in Intellego and Mentem.

golias.name: Golias
golias.summary: An old magus who keeps the illusion of one just out of apprenticeship, with unkempt brown hair and innocent blue eyes. No one is fooled, and everyone is kept off balance wondering why. Blackthorn's best political dealer, the more so as no one knows what he is about; his magical interests are unknown.

goliard.name: Goliard
goliard.summary: Filia Flumen, the most vigorous maga at Blackthorn and its leader in all but name, perhaps born there; she took her parens's place when he passed into Final Twilight in 1187. Nearly ninety, she looks in her early forties, black hair streaked grey and bloodshot brown eyes, plainly dressed in undyed white but for the jewelled purple and crimson robes she wears for the meeting's ceremonies. She restored an ancient binding on an elemental spirit that was taking revenge on humanity with rockslides, and controls it still; decades later she led an expedition into the Atlantic and was found four years on, battered and unconscious, on the sands at Chester. Anyone who deals with Blackthorn deals with her: an effective negotiator who keeps her word, keen for friends among the covenants, who are wary.

fornax.name: Fornax
fornax.summary: Goliard's filia, whose parens still holds her sigil: a mature maga who looks in her mid thirties, plain, with lank hair and a scarred face, and never known to be polite. She is said to work Rego and Mentem, to make people entertain her.

prelum.name: Prelum
prelum.summary: Goliard's filia, her sigil held by her parens, a maga less than ten years: good-looking, with long red hair and good teeth, always polite and usually pleasant, though she can insult within every rule of courtesy. She has a remarkable talent for Vim.

aindread.name: Aindread
aindread.summary: A mature magus who came to Burnham soon after his apprentice's Gauntlet and has left only once since, to present Caitlin at the meeting. He answers no letters and writes none; his magical interests are unknown.

caitlin.name: Caitlin
caitlin.summary: Aindread's filia, a young maga who sometimes represents Burnham at the meeting: heavily freckled, with one blue eye and one brown, smartly but plainly dressed, polite to all, and unmoved by the most tempting offers. She has voted Sachiko's sigil since 1201.

focus.name: Focus
focus.summary: Scintilla's filius; nothing else is generally known of him.

scintilla.name: Scintilla
scintilla.summary: Came to Burnham from eastern Europe at the end of the twelfth century, bringing Focus. She is said to be a powerful fire maga, but has done nothing of note in Stonehenge.

sachiko.name: Sachiko
sachiko.summary: Probably female. The Tribunal first knew of her when Caitlin voted her sigil in 1201; it has appeared at every meeting since.

trutina.name: Trutina
trutina.summary: A quaesitor who joined Burnham in 1195 and has attended every meeting since, as custom demands. She says little, usually has her Redcap proxy vote with Iudicium, and pleads quaesitorial neutrality to avoid conversation. Very beautiful, long-haired and dark-robed, with a silver pendant of her House's badge; a mature maga of unknown interests.

ebroin.name: Ebroin
ebroin.summary: Primus of House Ex Miscellanea since 1216, young and vibrant, elected when Immanola was declared in Final Twilight. He has restored the Council of Four, giving each member nominal charge of three Tribunals and keeping Stonehenge for himself, and called a census of the House. His Council is ill chosen, its members respecting neither one another nor him, and those who meet him often take him for a bumbling fool, wrongly (DE p. 22; Houses of Hermes: Societates pp. 102-103).

gharad.name: Gharad
gharad.summary: The second eldest maga of Cad Gadu, worn harder by time than Immanola: nearly blind, and left by repeated Twilights seeing things that are not there; her delusions never harm her but can endanger others. She seldom leaves her sanctum.

gwrhyr.name: Gwrhyr
gwrhyr.summary: A blustering incompetent of the Columbae, the Welsh ward-makers, extremely old though he looks about fifty, with pepper-and-salt hair and beard and robes embroidered with mystic symbols. Not bright nor powerful, he demands "proper respect" but knows his limits; his best magic is Rego. By his age and standing he sits on Ebroin's Council of Four. He owns Cad Gadu's island in Welsh law (Houses of Hermes: Societates p. 112).

culhwch.name: Culhwch
culhwch.summary: Gwrhyr's filius, not his blood, who suffered his master's insecurities and grew into a bully fond of taking it out on mundanes; more talented than his pater, he looks forward to surpassing him. Small and thin, simply dressed, smelling of burning, and skilled with Ignem.

findabair.name: Findabair
findabair.summary: A young maga, stunningly beautiful, long-haired and blue-eyed, who uses magic to eat and drink all she likes without losing her looks and dresses to seduce. She sees how fallen the covenant is and whines about it to anyone who will listen, too wrapped in her pleasures to act; the young men of the covenfolk hang about her.

stephen_eruditus.name: Stephen Eruditus
stephen_eruditus.summary: Founder and leader of Libellus, about seventy though his longevity potion holds him at a look of thirty-five; trained in the Rhine Tribunal, a known taker of risks who has always come out ahead, and founding a covenant is the largest risk yet.

meles.name: Meles
meles.summary: A young magus of Libellus, newly arrived in the Tribunal.

gregorius.name: Gregorius
gregorius.summary: A young magus of Libellus, newly arrived in the Tribunal.

lucidia.name: Lucidia
lucidia.summary: A young maga of Libellus, newly arrived in the Tribunal.

jonaquil.name: Jonaquil
jonaquil.summary: A young magus of Libellus, newly arrived in the Tribunal.

justin.name: Justin
justin.summary: A young magus of Libellus, newly arrived in the Tribunal.

fabricor.name: Fabricor
fabricor.summary: A young magus of Libellus, newly arrived in the Tribunal.

maximianus.name: Maximianus
maximianus.summary: Founder of Nigrasaxa, a widely respected master of Corpus whose many important texts are mostly in its library: a theoretical Bonisagus who these last twenty years has turned to the Order's politics. Julia of Voluntas asked him to help, and he came to Stonehenge and founded a covenant to break the cycle of invalid meetings, recruiting young magi to strengthen it. Ancient, and thought close to Final Twilight.

edward_of_milton.name: Edward of Milton
edward_of_milton.summary: The covenant's warden and its eldest magus, a great teacher who loves to lecture and dispute, weak for his age since he studies mundane learning too. He looks in his late fifties and is vigorous with an eager student. He has trained five apprentices, an unheard-of number. He dresses as a cleric and is in minor orders as an exorcist; his magic is chiefly Mentem, so he is very good at it.

astrolabe.name: Astrolabe
astrolabe.summary: Probably the most brilliant magus in the Tribunal, perhaps the Order, who would be an archmage if he gave himself to magic; his passion is natural philosophy, and he has begun applying it to magic theory, which he says rests on shoddy physics. Edward's first apprentice, now old, he looks in his late thirties and is usually unkempt, but dresses well for company. He works closely with Amabel the Learned.

lumen.name: Lumen
lumen.summary: A young maga and obsessive bibliophile who keeps the library and wants every text she can get, classical authors and the Order's early magi above all, copying them herself or trading more useful books for them. She searches monasteries' libraries wearing a ring that makes her look a man, and carries it off well. Homely, short and gangly, practically dressed.

fredegisa.name: Fredegisa
fredegisa.summary: A quaesitor and reforming idealist, a brilliant young student of civil, canon, common and Hermetic law, who devises new structures of Hermetic law and dreams of an age of justice for all magi. Smart, severe and attractive, she makes a good impression until her talk turns to her reforms.

gerfallon.name: Gerfallon
gerfallon.summary: Leader of Semitae since its first record in 1151, unaged since, of no fixed age or sex: tattooed all over, the hair shaved for more room, under a deep hood and long sleeves; his appearance may change in mid-conversation, or hold for a whole meeting. He will not speak of his past or purpose, which, he says, no one can understand who has not glimpsed the Enigma. Some forty years ago magi of Cad Gadu found him etching designs into a Snowdonian mountainside by magic; months later they were finished, a map of no one knows what.

vanasalus.name: Vanasalus
vanasalus.summary: A young maga with no tattoos on face or hands, dressed as a noblewoman in clothes embroidered with mystic symbols, good-looking and always friendly. She believes magic reflects the heart, so that malice brings vicious Twilights and good deeds good ones, and means to live magic, following Gerfallon about the country, until she understands the Enigma.

junius.name: Junius
junius.summary: An old magus at the height of his powers, dressed as a craftsman, clean-shaven, face and hands spotted with tiny burn scars; he looks puny, and his enchanted tools make his smithing surprising. He builds the covenant's wagons, but spends most of his time on a secret project he will not speak of. The Tribunal and his House are curious.

edward_the_white.name: Edward the White
edward_the_white.summary: A member of Semitae in name, gone to explore distant lands with his sigil, so the covenant has not his vote; no one expects to see him again. The Fourth Edition's The Mythic Seas tells more.

flavius.name: Flavius
flavius.summary: Ungulus's leader, trained there in its glory, who remembers its Verditius magi. He knows it is falling apart and cannot abandon it nor save it, and means to hold on until the others die or pass into Twilight and then rebuild with magi who are not fresh from apprenticeship; he is already courting the Tribunal's younger magi. Long a frequent, frustrated attender of meetings, often the only one not of Blackthorn, a passable politician sidelined in the revival. He looks late middle-aged, stout, balding and brown-bearded, in magnificent robes with powerful devices, to remind people of what Ungulus owns.

aquila.name: Aquila
aquila.summary: An ancient maga who spends most of her time as an eagle on the Lake District's thermals and seldom attends council; Flavius holds her sigil for good. She will likely pass into Final Twilight soon, staying in her heartbeast, and no one knows how the covenant would tell, or whether it already has.

sinead.name: Sinead
sinead.summary: An ancient maga who loved Parsirus and burns to avenge him on the dragon: anyone who wants something of Ungulus, membership included, she asks to kill it. She has tried twice herself and barely lived; the second time she fell into Twilight, and now a magical force pushes her away from her enemy. She looks an old woman in rich, worn robes, her magic bent on fighting magical beasts.

viator.name: Viator
viator.summary: The only Gifted Redcap in the Tribunal, retired to Ungulus for the resources to make a way for covenants to talk by magic without weakening their defences against one another, and fiercely against new members until it is done. Weather-beaten and nearly bald, he dresses opulently to meet people, if not as richly as Ungulus could.

espera.name: Espera
espera.summary: Offended a faerie lord long ago, and has lived to survive him since: she never leaves the Aegis, presses for it to be strengthened, and will let no one join lest they be faeries seeking a place in its ritual. She wears enchanted iron against faeries and often changes her looks by Muto Corpus to confuse her enemy.

julia.name: Julia
julia.summary: Voluntas's leader in all but name, who decides its dealings with the world. Tall, long black hair, pale skin and a fine low voice, in deep blue robes embroidered with silver; a mature maga of Corpus and Mentem. She came to Stonehenge in the civil war to study its shifting alliances, turned to the Order's politics as Henry II brought peace, and spent years persuading magi to stand against Blackthorn, staying away from meetings so that it could force nothing through; that led to the fiasco of 1194. She wrote to friends outside the Tribunal, Maximianus among them, and the quorate meeting of 1201 was her masterstroke. Her try to move the meeting from Blackthorn was out-manoeuvred, and she is still all but obsessed with weakening it.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.summary: A mature magus with a raven heartbeast and a gift for Intellego, who always seems to know things before he is told, so that he is suspected of scrying on the Order; nothing is proved, and he says it is often an act. Black-haired and dark-eyed, he stares, and rarely troubles to dress after changing back; when dressed, he wears black.

kirist.name: Kirist
kirist.summary: A young Flambeau in red robes with a fiery temper and Ignem magic, but committed to the good of the whole Order and aware that burning people is not always it: he argues for conciliation when he thinks it right, unless someone angers him.

phessallia.name: Phessallia
phessallia.summary: Disliked by most magi of the Tribunal: close to the faeries of winter and as cold to everyone, often away in the north, studying, she says, the fay of the frozen lands, with faerie items of the kind only given as gifts. She always wears white, her skin covered in a fine net of scars; an old maga thought skilled in Perdo.

desiderius.name: Desiderius
desiderius.summary: A necromancer in plain brown robes trailing the smell of rotting flesh, who long cared nothing for the living but lately has come out of his shell and tries, without the skill, to be sociable; people are too frightened to be rude to him.
